target_dataset: Custom VM Telemetry (45 samples: 13 Benign, 32 Malware)

primary_shift_drivers: Exclusion of vad_protection_anomaly_count: MalMem's vad_protection_anomaly_count is a dataset-specific proxy (malfind.commitCharge > 0) rather than true VirtualProtect protection alteration (InitProtection != Protection). It is classified as MALMEM_SPECIFIC_PROXY and strictly excluded from this zero-shot shared feature vector.

VAD Scope Discrepancy: Custom vadinfo scans all committed user/kernel memory regions, whereas MalMem's rwx_page_count was extracted from candidate injections identified by malfind.protection. Clean Windows 11 JIT runtimes (PowerShell/.NET) create legitimate RWX pages that the public model may penalize.

Omission of Memory Entropy and YARA: Shannon entropy and shellcode signature matches are completely absent from the public model, removing the ability to verify whether injected RWX memory contains encrypted shellcode.
